page.overview:
Who is Duty Manager?

He appears to be a red safety whistle with arms and legs with white safety markings all over his body. He appears similar to the Lifeguard except he is much more wrinkly and he has no hair.

He appears to be rational while still taking his job seriously. He appears to take charge of the water park in a respective manner and also seems to be respected by his employees.
